title: SEC1: now_unix=1_000_000_000 coupling to backoff cap
description: crates/kithd/tests/harness.rs:725. offline_delivery_and_retry passes now2=1_000_000_000 to override backoff. The block comment at line 578-579 explains the intent but the inline comment at line 723 says only 'far future' without naming the worst-case next_attempt_at. The actual worst case after one failure is now+36 (base=30s, +20% jitter, attempt_count=0). now2=1_000_000_000 vs now=1_000_000 is ~31.7 years ahead, which is safe. However: if the backoff cap (currently 3600s) is raised (e.g. to hours), now2 must increase too or the test will fail to fetch a due entry and silently pass with no delivery. The comment should state 'now2 must exceed now + max_backoff_with_jitter (currently 3600*1.2=4320s)' so a future maintainer knows the invariant to preserve.
